status_fields.native/report.json: status=measurement_complete; exit_code=worker_exit_code=0; stderr_complete=true; fixture_cleanup.error absent/null; summary.passed=true

artifact_family.source_binding: build.source_commit=固定产品源；source-before=source-after，source_manifest_sha256/driver_source/Cargo release artifact/保留 binary 的 SHA256+BLAKE3 全部匹配。每片 build_receipt_sha256、source/driver/binary 与同一 build 相等；原 raw engine/plan/digest 再核验。
artifact_family.replay: scripts/p8_scale_matrix.py 的 validate_build、validate_shard、aggregate/combine：重读原 raw 和完整 inventory；不得只信 matrix 的 passed。

common_acceptance_rules: 原 hard depends_on 先闭合；既有已接受前置无需无理由重跑。各 task 的原旧功能回归、Vxx 适用断言和既有 CI/source guard 不省略；原硬正确性失败不能由性能或控制测试抵消。
当前证据保留真实 run/命令/退出/profile/固定源/Cargo build/binary/raw 绑定；旧源历史只保留原适用范围。旧 binary 回滚的 previous source 是明确登记的必要例外。
accepted_scoped 源码审批、seal/verify 完整性、observation passed、task done 分别判断；不修改原 report 的 task_complete=false/release_certified=false。原范围及依赖满足后由独立审查给权威任务表作 done 决策。
required case 的 not_run/incomplete/timeout 不由顶层 green 消除；明确对应的另一实际子矩阵可以补齐覆盖，但原 limited report 不改写。
原 unavailable/null、CI 不确定、disabled provider、OS cache 未清及 fake provider 边界保留；不新增 live、绝对 SLA 或稳定尾延迟要求。平台原条款允许 SDK blocker 解决或明确发布范围；当前登记为八单元。
本文所有 N/规模/时长/阈值取自固定 workflow/protocol，非新门槛。P8-017 本人 authored hygiene 的独立 reviewer 是 root。

required_inputs: Original GitHub build ZIP and independent artifact metadata
Every one of the 150 original GitHub shard ZIPs and its independent artifact metadata
Unmodified frozen 599 checkout with full crates/Cargo inventory and original drivers
extra_integrity_checks: Complete build and shard source inventory equality against exact Git 599
Source .rs/.toml and Cargo.lock BLAKE3 from the preserved binary hash operation compared to raw engine
Original ZIP size and SHA256 equality before extraction, after replay, and before deleting only the derived extraction
Compact values are the unchanged return from the original validate_shard; each is sealed and fed to unmodified combine only after 150 unique original artifact reviews
independent_replay.original_zip_retention: Keep every original ZIP and metadata in durable archive; never replace raw with compact summaries.

scope_limits: Full P8-005 and P8-006 require all registered actual samples and relevant current original regression gates; a passed single shard or build cannot close either task.
Heterogeneous hosts are reported as separate environment strata; N=30 is total registered coverage, not 30 per stratum or certified stable tails.
No best-of, cross-workload speedup, same-environment causal comparison, real semantic/provider effect, or G8/release certification is inferred.
Semantic disabled and vectors unavailable/null remain explicit; no synthetic vector count or cost zero is substituted.
Worker snapshots are not continuous peaks or whole-process-tree memory certification.
Cold index/parse-cache state does not imply OS page-cache eviction.
The native original 15-table parity projection and full fresh controls are retained; missing, budget-exceeded, failed and timeout outcomes cannot be omitted or relabeled.
Utility controls that read old 6e3 raw are labeled old-source helper checks and contribute zero samples to run 37835810882.
